name: bookspace
description: Multi-tenant equipment and room booking for university departments.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w @bookspace/api" "npm run dev -w @bookspace/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bookspace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bookspace/api && npm run typecheck -w @bookspace/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bookspace/api && npm run test:restore-guard
